items.title: 2.10 Electronic configuration aur semiconductors ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.10, printed pages 41-42.

blocks.text: Semiconductors woh materials hain jo kuch halaat mein bijli guzarte (conduct) hain; yeh bohat se electronic aalaat mein istemal hote hain, smartphones, laptops aur garion samet. Silicon, germanium aur arsenic woh anasir hain jo semiconductor ka kaam kar sakte hain, aur semiconductors in anasir ki munfarid electronic configuration ki wajah se banaye ja sakte hain. Silicon (Z = 14) ki configuration 2, 8, 4 hai, to us ke valence shell mein chaar electrons hain. Khalis crystalline shakal mein har silicon atom chaar doosre silicon atoms se bandha hai, aur is shakal mein crystal mein se electronic conduction ka koi imkan nahi.

P-type aur N-type semiconductors khalis semiconductor mein milawat (impurity) ke atoms dal kar, doping se, bante hain. Boron ya aluminium jaisi trivalent impurities dalne se P-type semiconductor banta hai, jabke phosphorus ya arsenic jaisi pentavalent impurities dalne se N-type. Farq is mein hai ke impurity lattice mein holes, musbat charge carriers, banati hai (P-type) ya izafi electrons, manfi charge carriers (N-type).

blocks.alt: Neele silicon atoms ki teen chhoti murabba lattices jo lakeeron se juri hain aur jin par bandhan wale electron joron ke nuqte hain. Pehli khalis hai. Doosri mein darmiyan surkh aluminium atom hai jis ke saath ek khali daira hole likha hai. Teesri mein darmiyan sabz phosphorus atom hai jis ke saath ek izafi sabz nuqta extra electron likha hai. Neeche ek dabba doping samjhata hai.
blocks.caption: Khalis silicon aur us ki p-type aur n-type semiconductors mein doping (Figures 2.17 aur 2.18 ke mutabiq asal schematic).
blocks.long_description: Khalis silicon mein har atom apne chaar valence electrons chaar bandhanon mein baantta hai, to koi electron azad nahi aur crystal conduct nahi karta. Silicon atom ki jagah aluminium jaisa trivalent atom rakhne se ek bandhan kam reh jata hai, ek hole jo musbat carrier ki tarah bartao karta hai: p-type semiconductor. Us ki jagah phosphorus jaisa pentavalent atom rakhne se paanchwan electron manfi carrier ke taur par azad rehta hai: n-type semiconductor. Bairooni source se jorne par dono conduct karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Khalis silicon conduct kyun nahi karta, halanke us ke paas chaar valence electrons dastiyab hain?
blocks.explanation: Chaar valence electrons mein se har ek parosi silicon atom se bandhan mein band hai, to crystal mein charge le jane ke liye koi azad electrons ya holes nahi. Sirf doping, jo holes ya faltu electrons jorti hai, current ko behne deti hai.

items: Semiconductors (Si, Ge, As) kuch halaat mein conduct karte hain; khalis silicon (2, 8, 4) poori tarah bandha hai aur conduct nahi karta.
Trivalent atoms (B, Al) se doping holes wala p-type deti hai; pentavalent atoms (P, As) se izafi electrons wala n-type.
